body.title: Merge and finish into today's DimensionResult
body.summary: Each model dimension's finish handles a divided review (replacing today's 'dividing a code review is not available yet' error): the chunk results (coverage symbol findings, quality findings and pair findings) in stage order; gather.merge concatenates them with the obligation and relation parts, keeps identical findings once, re-asks a finding located at a note id rather than rewriting it, and applies each dimension's existing result filters: today's changed-set filter on the daemon path (findings outside it dropped, as today), functional coverage's known-FR expectationRef filter, and normalizeCoverageFindings run once over coverage's merged result with the prepared grounding. On the controller path out-of-set findings still reach the step handler's outOfScope handling (src/daemon/steps/code-review-step/handler.ts) as today. pipelineCalls is set by s1 and absent on a single-chunk review; runCodeReview folds with foldVerdict unchanged.
acceptanceChecks: merge keeps identical findings once and normalises coverage once over the merged result; it never rewrites a location: a gather finding located at an evidence note id (or anything not file:line) is re-asked once with the reason, then fails the review (the approved LLD, stakeholder option A).
Out-of-set findings are dropped on the daemon path and kept in outOfScope on the controller path, as today.
A functional-coverage finding with an unknown expectationRef at a valid changed-file location is dropped by finish, as today.
pipelineCalls counts the divided review's calls per role and is absent on a single-chunk review.
runCodeReview's signature, record shape and foldVerdict rule are unchanged.
